productionDate.note: The museum dates the manuscript to the Western Jin; the range runs from the start of that period to the writer's death and is not a reconstruction of the writing year.

dimensions.note: The museum's object entry gives these figures for the paper and does not separate the mounting from the sheet.

currentCollection.note: The museum states that Zhang Boju and Pan Su donated the scroll to the state in 1956 and that it was transferred to the Palace Museum by the Ministry of Culture. The entry does not say which gallery holds it or whether it is on display.
currentCollection.noteZh: 馆方记 1956 年张伯驹、潘素夫妇捐献国家，由文化部拨交故宫博物院。页面未记现陈列于哪一展室，也未记是否常设展出。

provenanceEvents.summary: Zhang Boju and Pan Su donated the scroll, together with other works, to the state; the Ministry of Culture transferred it to the Palace Museum.
provenanceEvents.summaryZh: 张伯驹、潘素夫妇将包括此卷在内的书画捐献国家，由文化部拨交故宫博物院。

review.note: Draft object record from the Palace Museum entry read on 2026-11-23. Accession number, dimensions and the 1956 donation come from that page; the scroll was not examined and no condition report is cited.
review.noteZh: 草稿实物记录，依据 2026-11-23 阅读的故宫页面整理。文物号、尺寸与 1956 年捐献均出自该页；未核对原件，未引状态报告。

notes: The scroll is recorded as a paper handscroll; the mounting, colophons and seals are not described here because the cited page does not enumerate them.
No earlier provenance event is dated: the page lists owners from the Song court onward without years.
notesZh: 此卷著录为纸本手卷；所引页面未逐项列出装裱、题跋与鉴藏印，故不在此描述。
此前递藏不设系年：页面自宋内府以下只列藏家，未给年份。
